r4_intake_findings.expected_behavior: Every named oracle matches canonical FR identities (FR-001..FR-020). Cross-cutting tests (auth, concurrency, boundary, a11y) have separate IDs. Milestone evaluates READY only when all required items are READY + COMPLETED + (valid VERIFIED or explicit valid NOT_REQUIRED). Proof edge requires valid VERIFIED.
r4_intake_findings.actual_check_evidence: All 20 FR identities verified canonical in validation-plan.md Table 3.1; separate cross-cutting table added in Section 3.2. Milestone predicate calibrated in Section 2.2 and Section 3.1.

r5_intake_findings.title: Back navigation loses saved proof mode and breadcrumbs append ancestors
r5_intake_findings.problem: handleBackPrev() in R5 set detailMode = prev.mode, called openRecord() (which reset detailMode = 'record'), and then checked if (detailMode === 'proof'), which always evaluated to false, losing saved proof mode. Breadcrumb clicks appended ancestors rather than truncating trail.
r5_intake_findings.expected_behavior: Popped predecessor mode must be stored in a local variable across openRecord() to accurately restore proof view mode. Breadcrumb clicks must truncate navStack to return to the chosen ancestor without looping.
r5_intake_findings.actual_check_evidence: Stored const savedMode = prev.mode || 'record'; across openRecord(); invoked showProof() when savedMode === 'proof'. Implemented data-trail-idx truncation via navStack.splice(idx). Preserved centralized session cleanup on Close and Escape.
r5_intake_findings.limits: Visual rendering and interactive focus traps remain NOT_RUN / VERIFICATION_BLOCKERS.
